# CleaningDigital

> Web design, local SEO, AI SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing exclusively for cleaning companies. Focused on Calgary, Alberta, and working remotely with cleaning company owners across Canada and the United States. Founder and Lead Strategist: Nakul Chandra.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://cleaningdigital.ca/): Overview of services for cleaning companies
- [Services](https://cleaningdigital.ca/services.html): Brand design, web design, local SEO, AI SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, Meta ads, booking systems, support
- [Pricing](https://cleaningdigital.ca/pricing.html): Three fixed one-time website packages: $799, $1,299 and $1,899 CAD
- [Our work](https://cleaningdigital.ca/projects.html): Homepage designs built for cleaning companies
- [About](https://cleaningdigital.ca/about.html): Nakul Chandra and how CleaningDigital works
- [Contact](https://cleaningdigital.ca/contact.html): Book a discovery call
